questions.prompt: How many piano tuners are there in New York City?
reasoning: Estimate NYC population at 8 million, giving roughly 3 million households.
Assume about 10 percent of households own a piano, which is 300,000 pianos.
Assume each piano is tuned once every two years, resulting in 150,000 tunings per year.
If a tuner can tune 600 pianos a year, dividing total tunings by workload yields about 250 tuners.

questions.prompt: How many strands of human hair are on an average human head?
reasoning: A typical human scalp has an area of roughly 500 square centimetres.
Hair density on the scalp averages about 200 hairs per square centimetre.
Multiplying the scalp area by the hair density yields 100000 hairs.

questions.prompt: How many grains of sand are in a typical bucket of beach sand?
reasoning: Assume a standard bucket holds about 10 litres or 10000 cubic centimetres of sand.
Fine beach sand has grains with a volume of roughly one cubic millimetre, or 0.001 cubic centimetres.
Dividing the volume of the bucket by the volume of a single grain gives 10 million grains.
